scope: Desktop Team Bridge owner audit, a human-only read-only view of the signed-in owner’s designated chief of staff’s conversations. Preserve the distinction between owner and agent, and between screening verdict and message authorship.
tone: Clear, calm, non-technical, sentence case. Do not suggest the owner can post or change these messages.

glossary.chief of staff: The user’s designated personal agent; use each locale’s established chief-of-staff translation, not a literal job title when a product term exists.
glossary.screening: The agent’s admission decision, not confidentiality screening.
glossary.audit window: The bounded period in which the agent was a conversation member.

placeholders.{name}: A person’s display name; do not translate the placeholder.

width: Sidebar labels should be concise. Status and disclosure lines may wrap.
